concepts.def: Variety of life: genetic, species, ecosystem (term popularised by Wilson 1988).
Categorises species: LC, NT, VU, EN, CR, EW, EX; founded 1964 by International Union for Conservation of Nature.
Harvard biologist; theory of island biogeography (with MacArthur 1967); biophilia hypothesis 1984.
Continuous habitat divided into smaller patches; reduces connectivity, edge effects, genetic flow.
Current human-caused extinction crisis; rates 100-1000x background (Ceballos et al. 2015 PNAS).
1992 Rio treaty; targets in Aichi 2010 and Kunming-Montreal 2022 (30x30 by 2030).
